'''Mr. Clay''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[moisture farmer]] who neighboured [[Ariq Joanson]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Clay disliked [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] as a result of their destructive raid on his storage shed [[Time/Legends|sometime]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
